description_de: Minimalistischer Aquarell-Comic nach dem Styleguide «Visuelle Bibel» V1.2 (docs/BILDSTIL.md): warmweisses Papier, wenige dünne Linien, transparente Flächen, natürliche erwachsene Figuren, viel Weissraum. Gemalte Szenen je Bildfeld; Worte als Text darüber in der gewählten Sprache. Ersetzt in der App die Stile Symbol und Anime, wo vorhanden.

FIG-APOLLOS.description_en: Apollos: a man of about thirty, lightly bearded, petrol-blue mantle over a light robe, a scroll under his arm.

FIG-GRUPPE-DIENER.description_en: The servants: men and women of different ages in plain sand-coloured belted tunics with pale linen aprons, sleeves rolled up, bare-headed.

FIG-GRUPPE-GLAUBENDE.description_en: The believers: ordinary men and women of different ages in dove-blue robes with pale cream overmantles, bare-headed or with plain pale head coverings; dignified, not caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-IRRLEHRER.description_en: The deceivers: well-dressed men in plain grey-brown robes, one with a scroll; earnest, persuasive faces; never caricatured, no marks of any ethnic group or religion (no tassels, prayer straps, prayer shawls or skullcaps).

FIG-GRUPPE-JUENGER.description_en: The disciples: a few young and middle-aged men with beards in plain ochre and brown belted robes, bare-headed, staying close to Jesus.

FIG-GRUPPE-KINDER.description_en: Two teenage children of the elder in dove-blue tunics.

FIG-GRUPPE-MENGE.description_en: Jewish people of Jerusalem: men, women and children of different ages in everyday robes in sand, grey, blue-grey and white, some with simple plain head coverings; dignified and varied, never caricatured or stereotyped.

FIG-GRUPPE-OBERE.description_en: A local magistrate: a dignified man in a white mantle with a narrow dark border, holding a small scroll, with one attendant.

FIG-JESUS.description_en: Jesus: a Galilean man in his early thirties, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair, short full dark beard, warm brown eyes, olive skin, a kind and open face that is always fully visible like everyone else's; cream linen tunic and a muted terracotta-red mantle over one shoulder. No halo. He is the only person wearing terracotta-red.

FIG-MARIA-MUTTER-JESU.description_en: Mary, the mother of Jesus: clearly one generation older than her adult son, grey streaks in her dark hair visible under the veil, gentle lines around eyes and mouth, slightly stooped posture; blue-grey veil and blue-grey robe.

FIG-OBJ-BECHER-VOLL.description_en: A simple earthenware cup with red wine.

FIG-OBJ-BOOT.description_en: A small wooden sailing boat moored at the quay.

FIG-OBJ-BRIEF.description_en: A letter: a sheet of papyrus or a small rolled letter.

FIG-OBJ-KREUZ.description_en: A plain wooden cross of rough beams.

FIG-OBJ-KRUG-WASSER.description_en: Six large stone water jars: waist-high, heavy, plain, pale grey, clearly distinct from small clay pitchers.

FIG-OBJ-KRUG-WEIN-LEER.description_en: A small empty clay wine jug.

FIG-OBJ-PEITSCHE.description_en: A short whip made of a few knotted cords.

FIG-OBJ-SCHRIFTROLLE.description_en: A scroll on two plain wooden rods.

FIG-OBJ-SCHWEIN.description_en: Pigs: a few thin dark pigs.

FIG-ORT-SEE.description_en: The Sea of Galilee: open water with low hills far away.

FIG-ORT-STADT.description_en: A small Cretan town: a few plain whitewashed flat-roofed houses, drawn with a few lines.

FIG-ORT-TEMPEL.description_en: The temple in Jerusalem: tall pale limestone building and colonnades, drawn lightly.

FIG-PAULUS.description_en: Paul: a man in his late fifties, balding, grey-flecked dark beard, lined thoughtful face; a plain cream tunic and a deep maroon-brown mantle (clearly darker and browner than terracotta).

FIG-ROLLE-AELTESTER.description_en: An elder of the church: a mature man of about sixty, grey beard, bare-headed, a grey overmantle over a sand-coloured tunic.

FIG-ROLLE-ALTE-FRAU.description_en: An older woman with grey hair under a plain veil.

FIG-ROLLE-ALTER-MANN.description_en: An old man with a white beard in a plain robe.

FIG-ROLLE-ARMER.description_en: A poor man: thin, in a worn, patched sand-coloured tunic.

FIG-ROLLE-BRAEUTIGAM.description_en: The bridegroom: a young beardless or lightly bearded man in a muted violet festive robe with a wreath of small fresh flowers on his head.

FIG-ROLLE-FRAU.description_en: The elder's wife: a woman of about fifty with a plain pale veil and a dove-blue robe.

FIG-ROLLE-GAST.description_en: A traveller: a man with a walking staff and a dusty cloak.

FIG-ROLLE-HAENDLER.description_en: Money changers and dove sellers: ordinary bearded men of different ages with plain undyed headcloths, dignified, never caricatured.

FIG-ROLLE-JUNGE-FRAU.description_en: A young woman with dark hair under a plain pale veil.

FIG-ROLLE-JUNGER-MANN.description_en: A young man of about twenty, short dark hair, light stubble, plain tunic.

FIG-ROLLE-MENSCH.description_en: A newly baptised man in a plain white tunic.

FIG-ROLLE-MUTTER.description_en: The mother: a woman of about forty-five with a plain pale veil and an ochre robe.

FIG-ROLLE-SKLAVE.description_en: A household servant (slave): a young man in a plain undyed short tunic; upright and dignified, no chains.

FIG-ROLLE-SOHN.description_en: The younger son: a thin young man of about twenty, short dark hair, sparse dark stubble, hollow cheeks; a torn, dirty, colourless tunic, barefoot.

FIG-ROLLE-SPALTER.description_en: A divisive man: a middle-aged man in a dull ochre robe, short beard, stubborn expression; dignified, not caricatured.

FIG-ROLLE-SPEISEMEISTER.description_en: The master of the feast: a portly older man, grey beard, receding grey hair, bare-headed, in an olive-green robe with a wide ochre-gold belt.

FIG-ROLLE-VATER.description_en: The father of the family: a man of about fifty in a sand-coloured robe.

FIG-TITUS.description_en: Titus: a man in his thirties, short curly dark hair, short dark beard; a moss-green robe, bare-headed.

FIG-ZEICHEN-STAMMBAUM.description_en: A very long unrolled scroll with a list of names (a family register).

FIG-ZENAS.description_en: Zenas the lawyer: a man of about forty, dark hair, short dark beard, brown robe with a pale wrap, a small wax writing tablet.
